Summary: Cashfree webhook route shadowed by user statement endpoint
RootCause: Parameterized route /api/wallet/:userId registered before webhook route causing JWT authentication on webhooks
RemediationApplied: Registered webhook route before parameterized routes and added reserved subpaths guard

Summary: TDZ ReferenceError on CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_PATHS in server.ts
RootCause: CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_PATHS declared at bottom of server.ts but referenced in top-level CORS middleware
RemediationApplied: Hoisted CASHFREE_WEBHOOK_PATHS constant declaration to top of server.ts before CORS middleware

Summary: Trailing slash on webhook path returned fallback status instead of canonical reachability
RootCause: Exact string comparison req.path === '/api/wallet/webhook' did not normalize trailing slashes
RemediationApplied: Added isCashfreeWebhookPath helper and normalized trailing slashes in cashfreeWebhookReachabilityHandler

Summary: Vercel deployment rejected with root command conflict in multi-service schema
RootCause: Top-level buildCommand and installCommand conflicted with per-service configuration
RemediationApplied: Removed top-level command overrides and restored exact multi-service vercel.json routing schema

Summary: Serverless runtime compilation timeout under NODE_ENV=production
RootCause: TypeScript build tools (typescript ts-node prisma) placed only in devDependencies
RemediationApplied: Promoted typescript ts-node prisma and @types to runtime dependencies in package.json
VerificationTest: Local npm run build and Vercel serverless build

Summary: Supabase Security Advisor flagged security definer view and unrestricted search path
RootCause: CustomerProfileView lacked security_invoker = true and helper functions lacked search_path locks
RemediationApplied: Applied migration 20261104_07 with security_invoker = true and locked search_path = public pg_temp

Summary: Unknown birth time evaluated undefined lagna ascendant coordinates
RootCause: Absence of birth time guard caused Swiss Ephemeris to compute speculative house cusps
RemediationApplied: Suppressed lagna bhavas and dashas when birth time is unknown while preserving graha rashis
